mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.005 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of easing cycle instances with positive INDPRO growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthening housing demand, foreshadows broader consumer spending growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, indicating rising inflation pressures, investors anticipate tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 35% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE rises above 5% and PAYEMS growth decelerates (< 100k new jobs), a weakening labor market reduces consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.005 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, enhances consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 30% of early-cycle expansion instances with positive RSAFS growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.
